copy.curiosityHook: After decades living in complete secrecy, can these forgotten operatives pull together and handle the modern crisis waiting for them?
copy.description: During the Cold War, the organization Patriot assembled a superhero squad from across Soviet republics. Forced underground for years, the hidden team is called back into the open when grave new threats emerge.
copy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, lighthearted, and exciting, making for an effortless, popcorn-ready squad adventure.
copy.whyWatch: Clocking in at a lean 89 minutes, it offers a brisk, Russian-language action-fantasy alternate take on the classic superhero ensemble formula with playful sci-fi energy.

allowedMaterial: Creation of the superhero squad by the Patriot organization during the Cold War
Members hailing from different Soviet republics
Heroes hiding their identities for years until hard times force their return
